main.description: A message in a channel. Lives in the author's own permissioned repo for the channel's space.

facets.description: Annotations over ranges of the text.

updatedAt.description: When the message was last edited. Absent means never edited.

parent.description: The message this one replies to.

forward.description: Content copied here from another message. Present only on a forwarded message.

suppressedEmbeds.description: URLs from this message's link facets whose preview the author chose not to show. Moderator suppression is a label instead.

forward.description: Another message's content, copied and frozen when the forward was made. The copy does not follow later edits, deletions or labels on the message it came from. Never itself nested: forwarding a forwarded message carries this content over and repoints `source` at the message it was forwarded from.

source.description: The message this content was copied from.

createdAt.description: When the message this content came from was sent.

text.description: The copied message body. Empty when the message that was forwarded carried only attachments.

facets.description: The copied annotations. A mention here does not notify anyone, because the AppView reads only a message's own facets.

attachments.description: The copied files, re-uploaded into the forwarding author's own repo so the forward stands on its own.

attachment.description: A file attached to a message.
